pedestrian_crossing_intention_qa.Question: Will the pedestrian located at [320, 818, 354, 937] in frame 1 cross the road? Justify your answer with spatial, temporal, mathematical, ego-vehicle, and scene-context reasoning. Conclude the pedestrian’s motives.

pedestrian_crossing_intention_qa.Conclusion: The pedestrian will not cross the road because they remain standing in place, looking away from the street, moving sideways along the sidewalk, and showing no signs of crossing preparation while the car continues at steady speed without creating a crossing opportunity.
